items.author: Dutch Rojas
items.text:
𝐈 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐀𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚 𝐢𝐧 𝟏𝟗𝟗𝟑. 

Two years later, I spent Christmas standing on the yellow footprints.

December 25, 1995.

A kid from the Netherlands about to get a very loud introduction to the United States Marine Corps.

I served from 1995 to 2003. 
I’ve had a few titles since then. 

Marine is the one I’ll carry for the rest of my life.

To everyone who stood on those footprints and earned the title, happy birthday, Marines! 

Semper Fidelis.

Rojas out.

items.author: Mac Vogt
items.text:
All preparation, all generosities, the towering pillar of humanity behind every step.

A world at an astonishing elevation.

A pleasingly anachronistic television set.

Suppose the teller could only feel this bank.

Suppose the healer gambled away the settlement.

Placed one hand on his chest.

The other on his stomach, eyes closed.

coverage: Six posts, Nov. 10–11, 2026. Compiled Wednesday, Nov. 11, ET.
